sourceState: Revision 1 is implemented and engine-substrate package green: the declarative interpreter executes authored, admitted, persisted definitions through the re-validating execution store and the broker-PEP only, in its own assembly so broker-only effect reach is compile-time; all 10 interpreter ledger cases green natively including the two execution-store binding architecture rows re-proven on Harborline assemblies. Revision 2 refuses, with workflow.interpreter.gate_unenforced, any selected transition or applied effecting action that declares a required role or standing, until the authorization gate that decides it is wired (DES-0019 workflows-eng-13). Revision 4 (T-488/interpreter-failure-outcome, ADR-0141/control 1237) records interpreter definition decision errors through the existing atomic advance as Failed/not-retryable naming the actual step, with no effect or retry. Refusals, cancellation and unrelated failures propagate unchanged. Revision 5 (T-1176/platform-gate-instant) carries the act decision instant from one host kernel TimeProvider read to every gate of the act, binds answers to DecidedAt, and ignores trigger time.
nextGate: Consume the interpreter from the Workflows package-only capability vertical (ticket 074); the vertical, not this substrate, flips the workflows capability gate.
